params.name: qd
params.let: 1 if (x > 0 and y > 0) else 2 if (x < 0 and y > 0) else 3 if (x < 0 and y < 0) else 4

params.name: names
params.let: {1: 'the first quadrant', 2: 'the second quadrant', 3: 'the third quadrant', 4: 'the fourth quadrant'}

params.name: wrong
params.let: [k for k in [1, 2, 3, 4] if k != qd]

solution: The first coordinate is {='positive' if x > 0 else 'negative'} and the second is {='positive' if y > 0 else 'negative'}.
Both signs together name the quadrant: this is {=names[qd]}.
notes: Reproduces the hand-written family tpl:u1-1-4:quadrant in generate_questions.py, item for item (decision 16 proof, tests/test_family_reproduction.py). Misconception ids are the catalogue's (seed/generated/misconceptions.json), which the live bank carries. Not loaded by anything: the live Prep-3 bank is the committed export.
